integrity: The assertions are proved for continuous positive diffusivity and smooth drift on a compact reflected interval with exact full curves. Numerical examples are checks, not a proof; no claim of independent scientific validation is made.
scientific_limitations: Requires smooth complete mean-passage profiles for two opposite reflecting-to-absorbing experiments using exactly the same Itô interior dynamics.
Spatially varying diffusivity is inferred by differentiating the measured profiles twice; the inverse is not continuous under C^1 measurement perturbations.
Classical scale/speed methods supply the foundational equations; an unindexed equivalent paired-MFPT statement cannot be excluded.
title: Two-boundary mean-passage tomography: a complete compatibility criterion and sharp instability
